**New: Potato shadows switch.**

Sets **Shadows** and **Shadow Map** to Low in any profile, so you keep Balanced quality everywhere else while getting the biggest FPS gain on weak GPUs and laptops. It only uses Low, the lowest value the in-game menu allows.

- **Web app:** tick *Potato shadows* under the profiles: https://j0p3s.github.io/Delta-Force-Tweaker/
- **Windows script:** menu option **[P]** in `Delta-Force-Tweaker_v1.1.0-beta.cmd` (download below)

> **Warning:** Team Jade has warned that editing config files outside the game may lead to anti-cheat penalties. Writing the config file is optional and at your own risk; setting the values in the game menu is risk-free.
